picks.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
picks.summary: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday. [...]

picks.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
picks.summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

picks.title: Hackers reportedly breached CIA intelligence analysis system
picks.summary: Unknown attackers have reportedly breached an open-source intelligence analysis system at the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) [...]

picks.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
picks.summary: 1Password has disclosed a data breach after a an employee s corporate GitHub account was hacked and used to deploy malicious code to the company s backend services to steal customer data. [...]

picks.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
picks.summary: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

picks.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
Bitcoin miners hit by hashrate hijacking attack exploiting unencrypted connections
picks.summary: Braiins warns that an attacker is redirecting miners compute power to steal bitcoin mining rewards.

picks.title: Palo Alto Networks warns of Fragnesia flaw exploited in PAN-OS attacks
picks.summary: Threat actors are chaining exploits for the PHP2Shell and Fragnesia vulnerabilities to target Palo Alto Networks devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. [...]

picks.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
picks.summary: Eclypsium s November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. [...]

picks.title: 1Password Says Breach Exposed Account Data, Not Vaults
picks.summary: The company says an attacker copied account information for a subset of customers through a compromised employee GitHub account. It advises vigilance against phishing, not password resets.

picks.title: US Treasury information chief spent three days vibecoding Civilization game clone amidst Treasury database hack
picks.summary: Legatum, a vibecoded browser-based Civilization clone by the US Treasury s own CIO is getting constant updates while the Treasury faces a cybersecurity issue.

picks.title: A familiar Iranian hacking group has found a new way to cause chaos
picks.summary: France blames an Iranian cyber unit for sabotaging hundreds of supermarket freezers.
